description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt firmware upgrade process. It includes functions for checking the firmware image and performing upgrades tailored to specific hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the firmware image is appropriate for the specific hardware board by inspecting the bootloader version.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade steps based on the hardware board type, extracting and placing firmware components accordingly.
